   "source": [
    "%%time\n",
    "groupby='Subclass'\n",
    "cosg.cosg(adata,\n",
    "    key_added='cosg',\n",
    "    # use_raw=False, layer='log1p', ## e.g., if you want to use the log1p layer in adata\n",
    "    mu=100,\n",
    "    expressed_pct=0.1,\n",
    "    remove_lowly_expressed=True,\n",
    "    n_genes_user=adata.n_vars, ### Use all the genes, to enable the calculation of transformed COSG scores\n",
    "    # n_genes_user=100,\n",
    "    groupby=groupby,\n",
    "    return_by_group=True, \n",
    "    verbosity=1\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },

    "\n",

   ]

    "### Calculate normalized COSG scores for each gene across all cell types"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "8111afe5-b06d-4c2a-be35-b69ce32c980c",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "In addition to COSG scores, the normalized COSG scores (or the transformed COSG scores) can also be calculated to enable cross-cell type comparison of the gene expression specificities. This could also potentially enables the expression specificity comparison across datasets or stuides.\n",
    "\n",
    "Note: setting `n_genes_user = adata.n_vars` in the `cosg.cosg()` function is required for calculation of normalized COSG scores."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "a011768d-15c4-433b-b4a1-6030b1e22343",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [

    "We could run COSG with `batch_key` set as \"Severely Affected Donor\", computing cosine similarities separately for each batch before averaging them. The COSG scores were then derived from these averaged similarities."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 36,
   "id": "775b50c8-1e59-4931-adaf-d4b6116fa64d",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Finished identifying marker genes by COSG, and the results are in adata.uns['cosg_batch'].\n",
      "CPU times: user 8.06 s, sys: 3.47 s, total: 11.5 s\n",
      "Wall time: 11.5 s\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "%%time\n",
    "groupby='Subclass'\n",
    "cosg.cosg(adata,\n",
    "    key_added='cosg_batch',\n",
    "    # use_raw=False, layer='log1p', ## e.g., if you want to use the log1p layer in adata\n",
    "    mu=100,\n",
    "    batch_key='Severely Affected Donor', ### Set the batch key\n",
    "    batch_cell_number_threshold=5, ### Minimum number of cells required in a batch for a given cluster to be considered \n",
    "    expressed_pct=0.1,\n",
    "    remove_lowly_expressed=True, \n",
    "    n_genes_user=adata.n_vars, ### Use all the genes, to enable the calculation of transformed COSG scores\n",
    "    # n_genes_user=100, \n",
    "    groupby=groupby,\n",
    "    return_by_group=True, \n",
    "    verbosity=1\n",
    ")"
